name: The Peninsula London
positioning: Peninsula hotel alongside Hyde Park Corner and Wellington Arch, with Peter Marino-designed rooms, a heated pool with underwater music and a motorsport-themed rooftop restaurant and bar
best_for: Travelers who want a base across the road from Hyde Park
Guests who want rooftop dining and drinks with London skyline views

facts.text: The hotel sits alongside Hyde Park Corner and Wellington Arch.
Hyde Park is a hop across the road, and Knightsbridge is a stroll to the west.
Rooms and suites are designed by Peter Marino, combining contemporary British character with residential comfort.
The Peninsula Suite's living room has a fireplace and a baby grand piano.
Brooklands by Claude Bosi is a rooftop restaurant inspired by British motorsport.
Brooklands Bar is a rooftop cocktail bar with views across the London skyline.
The Lobby serves an all-day menu and is home to The Peninsula's signature Afternoon Tea.
The pool is heated and has underwater speakers so guests can listen to music as they swim.
The spa has separate steam and sauna rooms for men and women and a relaxation lounge with heated lounge chairs.
The hotel's fleet includes Rolls-Royce Phantom VIIs, a Bentley Bentayga and an electrified Austin Taxi.
There is a shopping arcade with nine boutiques, including Moussaieff and Asprey.
Small domestic pets are allowed, with pet-sitting and pet-walking available.

highlights.text: On the way to the rooftop, guests pass a 1933 Napier Railton car and a Concorde nose before a lift styled like a hot-air balloon.
Grand Premier Park Rooms have large picture windows overlooking Wellington Arch and the daily parade of the Household Cavalry.
The pool's illuminated overhead light panels change through the day to simulate natural sunlight.
The Lobby has hand-blown crystal chandeliers and de Gournay murals depicting scenes of nearby Hyde Park.
Canton Blue is designed by Henry Leung of Cap Atelier to reflect the contents of the 19th-century trading ship the Keying junk.

considerations.text: There is no kids' club, but a Children's Program offers board games, treasure hunts and in-room treats.
The hotel is 23.8 km (14.8 miles) from London Heathrow Airport.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the ultra-luxury positioning.
